title: NOAA North Atlantic wind on the WGS84 globe
source: NOAA PSL NCEP-NCAR Reanalysis 1, daily sigma 0.995 east/north wind, January 1-8 2024
placement: Wind 20000 m, speed layer 1000 m, reference glyphs 100000 m above WGS84 ellipsoid; display placements only. Sigma is not altitude. No inferred vertical wind.
